title: Exceptions that stack on the same supplier
question: On which suppliers do two or more different exceptions to the ordinary contracting rules land?
finding: 220 suppliers carry two or more of six kinds of exception; 73 carry three or more and 38 carry four or more. Those 38 were paid $4.76 billion since fiscal 2019. At the top: Healthright 360 (6 kinds, paid $488.9 million); Baker Places Inc (6 kinds, paid $143.8 million); Chinese Hospital Association (6 kinds, paid $54.3 million); Tenderloin Housing Clinic Inc (5 kinds, paid $439.6 million).
how: Six tests, each from a different file, joined on the supplier’s name: (1) a contract since July 2018 awarded as sole source or under another "not bid" rule; (2) a contract under an ordinance that waives bidding, or on the lists of contracts excused from the local-business rule; (3) $100,000 or more paid under emergency powers, or an emergency contract; (4) a Board resolution approving its agreement after the term began (the “retroactive” results); (5) an agreement that at least doubled through amendments (the site’s “Audits and official documents” page, the 60 rows it lists and its organization signals); (6) a contract set between $9.5 million and $10 million, under the amount that needs a Board vote (the “contract thresholds” results). Ranked by number of kinds, then by City payments since fiscal 2019.
limits: A large provider of homelessness or health services will meet several simply because of its size and its field: the Board waived bidding for that work, the pandemic put it under emergency rules, and the Board’s calendar makes late approvals common. The count is a way to choose which files to read first, not a score of conduct. Name match across six files; other public bodies are left out. The amendment test covers only the agreements listed in the site’s “Audits and official documents” page. The paid figures count payments issued in fiscal 2019 or later, which is read from the voucher number and not from the year the file lists a line under; $1.08 billion that the whole payment file lists under those years was issued earlier and is left out.
